youtube_title: The doctor's lantern: Orr Lake Road's full-moon legend (La Porte)
body: Tonight's a full moon 🌕 On Orr Lake Road, legend says that's when the doctor walks. The story goes that sometime in the 1900s, a doctor lived out here with his wife and daughter. When they died, he couldn't let them go, and kept their bodies in barrels. On full-moon nights, people say his lantern moves into the woods beside a servant with a hook for a hand. There's no record any of it happened. People live on Orr Lake Road, so if you drive it tonight, keep rolling. #LaPorte #Haunted #Halloween #FullMoon #UrbanLegend #Indiana

youtube_title: Buried alive? Pine Lake Cemetery's darkest story (La Porte, Indiana)
body: When La Porte moved its old city cemetery in 1871, a story came up with the coffins ⚰️ Many of the dead were reburied at Pine Lake Cemetery, marked only as unknown. People say one woman was found upside down and twisted in her coffin, as if she'd been buried alive. Pine Lake also holds a mass grave: the bones of about ten unknown men from Belle Gunness's farm, split between two caskets. Visitors report shadows like mist above the stones. Please visit in daylight, and pull into the cemetery rather than stopping on US-35. #LaPorte #Haunted #Halloween #BelleGunness #Indiana #History

youtube_title: 4 places in La Porte County where the dead don't rest
body: 4 places in La Porte County where people say the dead don't rest 👻 4. Orr Lake Road, where a doctor's lantern is said to move through the woods under a full moon. 3. Pine Lake Cemetery, where shadows like mist drift over a mass grave of Belle Gunness's victims. 2. Patton Cemetery, where a neighbor says they hear people talking at night, and no one's there. 1. Posey Chapel Cemetery near Hesston: bells, bouncing lights and a woman in white. Which one would you visit? Tell us in the comments! Cemeteries are for daylight, and people live on Orr Lake Road, so keep rolling. #LaPorte #Haunted #Halloween #Indiana #GhostStories
